Acheson circular rejects claim Chinese intervention was spontaneous response; American diplomatic position, not independently proven Soviet plan.

US military staff discussion of possible evacuation: government 3,500; officers 1,000; soldiers 50,000; political figures 3,000; categories are planning estimates, not actual evacuations.
Sariwon alleged extrajudicial killing of 56 political detainees, 17 survivors reported by British press through US diplomatic records; allegation not independently adjudicated.
Interior Minister Cho Byeong-ok says police/interior staff must not evacuate families before ministry instructions; promises timely evacuation notice if needed.
